# Stoke Club

> Stoke Club is an indie surf rock band from Newport Beach, California, best known for the song Polaroid and for writing in the dreamy Mixolydian mode.

A group of friends who started making music together at the University of Southern California (USC) and started the band in 2025. We write and produce our own records.

## Facts

- Name: Stoke Club (also written Stoke Club Band)
- From: Newport Beach, Orange County, Southern California
- Formed: 2025
- Genre: indie surf rock, surf rock, indie rock
- Sound: much of our writing is in the Mixolydian mode, a major scale with a lowered seventh, which gives the songs a dreamy, open feel
- Best known for: Polaroid (released June 1, 2026)
- Also released: Crocodile Tears (released July 3, 2026)
- Next release: Your Friends (November 6, 2026)
